title: VerseAnalysisOutput
description: One verse audited against its Hebrew. Produced by the analysis pass, which never writes renderings.

accuracy_rating.description: A mixed cell -- arrangement apparatus alongside genuinely rendered text, which is the common case -- takes one of the first six and declares the extra material in non_source_material. Reserve no_source_basis for a cell that is apparatus and nothing else.

accuracy_note.description: What the English preserves of the Hebrew, in the psalm's own order.

creative_liberties_note.description: Where the English interprets, compresses or amplifies. Empty string when there is nothing of consequence.

literal_backbone.description: Compact literal rendering, one entry per clause. Evidence for the verdict, never a proposed rendering.

word_notes.description: Only words whose rendering is worth remarking on. An empty array is a valid and common answer.

token_ids.description: Token ids from the supplied evidence. Several ids when the note is about a bound phrase.

lexical_gloss.description: The word's range in the lexica, not this translation's choice.

non_source_material.description: Text in the English with no counterpart in the Hebrew: performance and arrangement apparatus.
